questions.question: When King David grew exhausted in battle and a Philistine warrior tried to kill him, who came to his aid?
After Abishai saved the exhausted King David from a Philistine, what did David's men swear to him?

answers.text: He must never go out to battle with them again
They will always fight right beside him
He must lead them from the very front

questions.question: In a battle with the Philistines at Gob, Elhanan son of Jair killed the brother of which famous Philistine?
When a huge man with six fingers on each hand taunted Israel in a battle at Gath, who killed him?

answers.text: Jonathan son of David's brother Shimei
Amasa son of David's sister Abigail
Absalom son of David's wife Maacah
